snippet.title: DICE OF KALMA | DEMO ANNOUNCEMENT TRAILER
snippet.description:
You're trapped in the Underworld, and your only way out is a game of chance against Kalma, its grim overseer. Dice of Kalma is a challenging roguelike deckbuilder where every run is a desperate bid for freedom. Collect skull cards, discover devastating combos, and roll the dice to cheat death and escape to the land of the living.
